shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100 && cat package.json && ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)"
for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx app/news/page.tsx; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; echo; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -20
npm run build 2>&1 | head -15; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json

cat > next.config.ts <<'EOF'
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
  partialPrefetching: true,
}

export default nextConfig
EOF
git checkout tsconfig.json
sed -i 's#"include": \["next-env.d.ts", "\*\*/\*.ts", "\*\*/\*.tsx", ".next/types/\*\*/\*.ts"\]#"include": ["next-env.d.ts", "**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx", ".next/types/**/*.ts", ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"]#' tsconfig.json
git diff tsconfig.json
rm -rf .next && npm run build 2>&1; git diff --stat tsconfig.json

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -b 'draft-title=Budget%20scoop' localhost:3123/preview | grep -o 'Budget scoop\|Untitled draft' | sort -u; curl -s localhost:3123/preview | grep -o 'Budget scoop\|Untitled draft' | sort -u; curl -sI localhost:3123/news | grep -i 'x-nextjs-cache\|cache-control'; pkill -f 'next start'; grep -rn "instant\|force-dynamic\|revalidate =" app || echo "no opt-outs or legacy segment configs"
grep -rn "instant\|force-dynamic\|revalidate =" app || echo "no opt-outs or legacy segment configs"; git status --short
